note: Regression for hif-backend#30, which dropped an output port's folded initial value and so lost the constant continuous assignment driving it. Behavioral rather than structural because the broken output compiles and reparses cleanly - the only symptom is that the output reads x, which no text or reparse check sees. Reuses behavioral_roundtrip rather than adding a pipeline: both sides are Verilog, so the strong reference-vs-regenerated comparison is available here.
